text:
megan: Quick sync — BigBank reserved capacity handshake tomorrow at 10. Need final decisions on three things before I send the contract draft: spillover behavior, canary/ramp windows, preemption credit visibility.
raj: On spillover, do we have appetite to permit cross-pool soft-spill for enterprise customers? they'd prefer soft-failover to lower-cost model rather than 429s.
ana (typo fix): actually it's ana :) but +1 to soft-spill option if it preserves request correctness. we should define strict QoS tiers for what can spill.
ana: we also need to decide if spilled requests count toward their committed usage or are billed at on-demand rates. finance will want clarity.
megan: proposal: soft-spill -> route to compatible lower-tier model (same family/quantization) with explicit SLA delta and billing at on-demand rates; provide opt-out flag per tenant. keeps correctness and clear invoicing.
sam: +1. Also recommend a 3-minute ramp canary for each major rollout, followed by a 30-minute warm window before full traffic. helps catch perf regressions.
raj: can we make ramp windows configurable per-customer? big accounts may want longer canaries. but default 3/30 is fine.
megan: yes default 3/30, overridable via reserved-pool config and annotated in the contract.
ana: about preemption credits — BigBank asked for a way to track how often they're preempted. ops-bot, can we expose a preemption ledger per-tenant?
ops-bot: deploy-bot says: we already emit preemption events to /events/capacity with fields {tenant_id, pool_id, preempted_at, preemption_reason}. we can add a daily aggregate endpoint and a CSV export. ETA 3 days.
megan: perfect. also need a short snippet for the contract appendix describing fallback semantics. drafting now — would like an ack from finance and legal before sending.
raj: I'll sync with finance on billing impact (on-demand vs committed) and confirm numbers by EOD.
sam: i'll add the canary config to the UI flow and mark it as adjustable per-reservation in the admin console.
ana: acceptance criteria checklist idea: 1) spill route implemented + opt-out; 2) billing rules documented; 3) canary defaults in infra + override UI; 4) preemption ledger export available; 5) rollout runbook updated with revert steps.
megan: great. owners: raj (billing), sam (UI/console), ana (acceptance criteria + runbook), ops-bot (preemption export). I'll send draft to legal once raj confirms billing language.
raj: noted, will ping finance now.
megan: thanks team — will post contract draft in #product when ready. :thumbsup:
